title: Catflare
description: Dive into a world where every block bursts with color! 🌈✨
body:
### CATFLARE HAS BEEN DISCONTINUED AND WILL NO LONGER BE UPDATED

Catflare transforms your Minecraft world, making everything look brighter and more colorful. Enjoy radiant landscapes, vivid villages, and a more vibrant experience. Dive into a world where every block bursts with color! 🌈✨

Compatible with most shaders! **Even though it says it isn't compatible, it works with Sodium!**

Any feedback is welcome since this is in early development!
